lines.speaker: god
lines.text: Seven pairs of every clean animal. One pair of every unclean. Two of every bird.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And then something impossible happened. The animals came to Noah.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Lions and lambs. Elephants and doves. Bears and deer. Marching, pair by pair.

lines.speaker: wife
lines.text: Are those... elephants? Walking TOWARD us?!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Noah provisioned the ark with food for every creature. It took days.

choices.label: Pack enough for a long journey 📦
choices.note: Every stall stocked. Every animal fed for weeks.

choices.label: Pack light — it won't last long 🤞
choices.note: Maybe the flood will be brief. Maybe not.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: When the last pair walked up the ramp, the ark was full. Seven days remained.
